place_fields.summary: Eyelusion is a 3D and augmented-reality gallery at Snowcity Mysore, offering optical-illusion and photo-oriented exhibits in the Ittige Gudu area of Mysuru.

planning_attributes.description: An indoor 3D and augmented-reality attraction associated with Snowcity Mysore, focused on interactive visual exhibits and photography.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The listing places Eyelusion at 145/2 Lokaranjan Mahal Road, Ittige Gudu, Mysuru, near Grand Vanam Hotel.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Follow on-site instructions for interactive exhibits and photography setups.
planning_attributes.notes: The supplied coordinates are preserved exactly.

place_fields.summary: GRS UpDown is an illusion-based photography attraction in Metagalli, Mysuru, with themed setups designed to create upside-down and perspective-based photo experiences.

planning_attributes.description: An indoor photography and illusion attraction beside GRS Fantasy Park on KRS Road in Metagalli, Mysuru.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: GRS UpDown is presented by its operator as an upside-down photography attraction and has received an award for Most Innovative Attraction at the Amusement National Award.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The operator places GRS UpDown on KRS Road beside GRS Fantasy Park, about 10 minutes from Mysuru city centre.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Online ticketing is available; the operator also states that students can receive a discount with a valid student ID at the ticket counter.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Follow venue instructions for the interactive installations; the operator lists standard attraction operating hours and visitor guidance on its site.
planning_attributes.notes: The supplied coordinates are preserved exactly.

place_fields.summary: Darbar Hall is the Public Darbar Hall of Mysuru Palace, also known as Sajje or Dasara Hall, and was historically used for the Maharaja's public audiences.

planning_attributes.description: A grand audience hall within Mysuru Palace, noted for its decorated ceilings, granite pillars and historic royal artworks.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The Public Darbar Hall was used for royal public audiences and is associated with Mysuru's Dasara traditions; the hall contains historic paintings including work attributed to Raja Ravi Varma.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Darbar Hall is inside Mysuru Palace in the Chamrajpura area of Mysuru.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Access is subject to Mysuru Palace visitor rules and operating arrangements; private royal darbar events can have restricted entry.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Follow Mysuru Palace visitor instructions and any restrictions around heritage interiors and ceremonial areas.
planning_attributes.notes: The supplied coordinates are preserved exactly.
